title: [GMCP 203.001.02] Production path: Normative requirements ledger and standards drift
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-001-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: A machine-readable requirements ledger covers every applicable MCP 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28 MUST, SHOULD, error, deprecation, security rule, official extension, and implementation claim. Every row traces to an owner, production path, positive and negative test, evidence artifact, and disposition; automated upstream drift detection fails closed on an unclassified change. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
